model.eligibility_note: Open weights; license apache-2.0 as published on huggingface.co/unsloth/Qwen3.6-35B-A3B-GGUF and on the Qwen/Qwen3.6-35B-A3B base model card, both read 2026-11-16 by the orchestrator. Quantisation Q4_K_M (listed in that repo as UD-Q4_K_M) as reported by the serving session. Served self-hosted via llama.cpp OpenAI-compatible endpoint on the VT ARC Falcon cluster (OnDemand LLM session, node fal045:34691, reached over an SSH tunnel on localhost:8080); no third-party inference provider. An earlier session on node fal039:39247 served the same model and quant on 2026-11-16 and auto-terminated on idle; the eleven research runs completed that day used it. Thinking/reasoning output is left enabled, as the model ships, by project decision; max_tokens raised to 32000 because reasoning tokens share the completion budget. Apache-2.0 is an OSI-approved licence, so this slot qualifies as open-source as well as open-weight.

tool_access: chat-completions API only: no browsing, no shell, no filesystem. The orchestrator wrote every file and ran every check.

approved_source.limitations: No individual article pages were mapped in this evidence set; only section fronts and topic pages were fetched.
approved_source.approval_reference: Project lead approval given 2026-11-16 in the Claude Code orchestration session for open-source slot 07; see that session transcript and research/NEWS-05.md
